observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless gas cooker with 4 visible burners on the top (2 left burners, 2 right burners) and control knobs on the front panel.
Photo 1 shows the same cooker from another angle with 4 burners visible and flames lit on multiple burners.
Photo 2 shows the oven door and front panel; the top appears to be a 4-burner layout (no extra burners visible).
No brand/model label is readable in the provided photos.

claims.claim: 4 Gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total.
claims.evidence: Across photo 0 and photo 1, only 4 burners are visible on the cooker top; no second unit or extra 2 burners are shown.
Photo 1 shows flames, but there is no clear proof of full functionality (e.g., oven heating, thermostat, burner stability) and no close-up of all burners/controls.

risks.risk: The seller may be bundling two cookers (or claiming 6 burners) but only one 4-burner cooker is shown in the photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the full set laid out (both cookers) or a clear wide shot confirming 6 burners total.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single 4-burner gas cooker (worst case: not the claimed 6-burner setup).

risks.risk: Oven may not heat properly even if burners light (common fault: igniter/thermostat/door seal).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the oven being turned on with temperature/heat visible (or a thermometer reading) for several minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as burners working but oven unproven (worst case: oven not working).

risks.risk: Burner performance issues (uneven flame, weak ignition, clogged jets) not fully testable from one photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing each burner igniting from cold one-by-one and maintaining a steady blue flame.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed (worst case: needs servicing).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect gas parts (regulator, knobs, burner caps) or damaged burner grates not visible clearly.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of all burner caps/grates and the control knobs, plus the back panel connection area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may require replacement parts.

proof_requests: Confirm whether it is 1 cooker or 2 cookers; send a wide photo showing the full quantity and total burner count (6 if that’s the case).
Send a short video of the oven heating (turn on oven, show flame/heat and how long it takes to warm).
Send a video where each of the 4 burners ignites individually from cold and stays steady.
Send close-ups of burner caps/grates, all knobs, and the gas connection/back panel.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a single 4-burner gas cooker, which contradicts the seller’s 6-burner claim. Also, “working perfectly” is not fully provable remotely without oven and full burner-by-burner testing.
